classification: source-linked repository analysis; no live factory data asserted

invariants.lifecycle: DRAFT -> APPROVED -> RELEASED; CLOSED is terminal in current service surface
invariants.owner_scope: created_by_id and mrp_run_id; no company_id or warehouse_id on plan, warehouse is inherited from MRPRun
invariants.dates: start_date/end_date required; ordering and horizon bounds must be validated by service
invariants.locks: line lock count is denormalized; plan row should serialize release and recalculation
invariants.nullability: mrp_run_id and created_by_id nullable; unscoped run cannot safely feed coupled projection
invariants.transaction: approval/release endpoint uses one AsyncSession transaction; release must roll back as a unit
invariants.permission: mps.approve/mps.release; warehouse/company scope must also be checked
invariants.current_enforcement: DRAFT guard, run identity linkage; no approval readiness audit in baseline
invariants.counterexample: approve a DRAFT with no lines or with MATERIAL_SHORT lines; release a plan with no source warehouse scope
invariants.recommended_fix: require feasible lines, source warehouse scope, row lock, and before/after audit records

invariants.owner_scope: mps_id scopes line; product_id points to shared master
invariants.uom: no line UOM; must match Product.uom, demand UOM, recipe/BOM and supply before arithmetic
invariants.dates: period_start/end required; planned dates nullable; within-plan ordering not DB-enforced
invariants.locks: is_locked protects planner overrides; engine must retain locked quantity, dates, WC, and campaign
invariants.uniqueness: line_no globally unique; no plan/product/period uniqueness constraint
invariants.nullability: MRP link, work center, dates, hours, batch and production order nullable
invariants.transaction: generation deletes/recreates unlocked lines; must lock plan and keep deletes/inserts atomic
invariants.permission: mps.edit/calculates; route must bind both plan and line IDs
invariants.current_enforcement: planner schema excludes engine fields; T002 fixes plan-bound update; capacity baseline skipped locked loads
invariants.counterexample: same line ID submitted under another plan; locked line omitted from capacity load; UOM mismatch treated as feasible
invariants.recommended_fix: preserve plan-bound updates and locks; use explicit UOM and persistent per-line reasons; avoid default capacity

invariants.lifecycle: forecast header must be APPROVED and is_approved; line may carry adjusted_qty override
invariants.owner_scope: header warehouse_id optional; forecasts without exact plan warehouse cannot be safely coupled
invariants.uom: product UOM implied; forecast line has no explicit UOM
invariants.dates: header start/end plus line period_date; period type DAILY/WEEKLY/MONTHLY
invariants.locks: approved forecast should be treated as source snapshot
invariants.uniqueness: header unique by product/period/date/model; line unique by forecast and date
invariants.transaction: demand projection uses one plan transaction
invariants.current_enforcement: MRP run aggregates demand; initial MPS generation fractionally spread totals across horizon
invariants.counterexample: confirmed orders and forecast both count in one bucket; forecast receipts outside run warehouse leak into plan
invariants.recommended_fix: bucket by dates, net confirmed against forecast per bucket, require matching warehouse, conserve quantity

invariants.lifecycle: confirmed/allocated/picking remain open demand; shipped quantity is fulfilled; cancelled/draft excluded
invariants.owner_scope: order company_id and warehouse_id; project only exact MRP warehouse
invariants.uom: line unit must equal product UOM unless a configured conversion exists
invariants.locks: source orders are never modified by MPS projection
invariants.uniqueness: order no and order-line no unique under SO
invariants.transaction: projection reads only; MPS line writes are atomic
invariants.current_enforcement: MRP demand helper filters order status; plan generator does not retain delivery date detail
invariants.counterexample: a warehouse-null confirmed order is counted for an unrelated plant; order PCS demand is netted against KG stock
invariants.recommended_fix: filter exact warehouse, honor open statuses and shipped quantities, reject unit mismatch

invariants.lifecycle: stock excludes blocked; open PO approved/ordered/partial; WIP planned/released/in progress
invariants.owner_scope: stock warehouse required; PO company; production target warehouse
invariants.uom: on-hand/reserved/available and incoming quantities must use product/material UOM
invariants.dates: PO expected_delivery_date and WIP scheduled_end determine supply period
invariants.locks: reserved inventory is unavailable; release/order links prevent duplicate supply
invariants.uniqueness: PO line unique by PO/line; production order number globally unique
invariants.nullability: PO product/material alternatives; schedule and actual quantity nullable in source model
invariants.transaction: supply read snapshot plus plan line writes in one transaction
invariants.permission: warehouse/company scope inherited from MRP run
invariants.current_enforcement: MRP results have aggregate supply fields; MPS generator previously used net requirement without dated components
invariants.counterexample: late PO treated as available; blocked stock counted; the same on-hand balance deducted in every period
invariants.recommended_fix: calculate available on-hand once, carry closing stock forward, include only dated matching-scope supply

invariants.lifecycle: BOM APPROVED/RELEASED or Recipe APPROVED, active, and effective for planned date
invariants.owner_scope: product master relation; material components require identified active material
invariants.uom: basis, output UOM, required UOM and material UOM must agree or use explicit conversion
invariants.locks: released source definitions are snapshots for planning
invariants.uniqueness: BOM code; recipe product/version; BOM line no; recipe line no
invariants.nullability: recipe has no output base quantity; legacy MRP scales item quantity per output unit
invariants.transaction: explosion and diagnostics occur within MPS evaluation transaction
invariants.permission: MPS calculate; quality/planner substitution approval required by policy
invariants.current_enforcement: MRP uses approved Recipe single-level; advanced BOM carries basis, yield, loss and substitute policy
invariants.counterexample: missing recipe returns empty requirement list and can pass feasibility; different KG/L bases multiplied directly
invariants.recommended_fix: use date-effective approved BOM, apply explicit basis/loss, fail closed on missing UOM/master, do not auto-substitute

invariants.lifecycle: only ACTIVE resource and explicit calendar dates can contribute capacity
invariants.owner_scope: work center ID; plan linked to MRP warehouse; source has no direct company scope
invariants.uom: capacity_uom must be a compatible product-UOM per hour rate
invariants.dates: calendar date, shift availability, maintenance/holiday flags, downtime interval
invariants.locks: locked lines consume capacity but may not be rescheduled/recalculated
invariants.nullability: capacity/rate UOM, end_time, duration may be null
invariants.transaction: replace slots and update feasibility atomically
invariants.permission: MPS calculate and scoped work center/plant
invariants.current_enforcement: legacy scheduler defaulted throughput and 8h Mon-Sat, ignored calendars and downtime
invariants.counterexample: a capacity_uom of KG is treated as units/hour; no calendar still yields FEASIBLE; locked loads omitted
invariants.recommended_fix: require explicit compatible rate/calendar, include downtime and locked load, report missing source as INFEASIBLE

invariants.lifecycle: recalculated snapshot tied to MPS run or planning scenario
invariants.uniqueness: MPS slot unique per plan/work center/date
invariants.transaction: delete/rebuild MPS slots in one transaction
invariants.current_enforcement: slot persists numeric overload but no structured per-line reason/provenance
invariants.counterexample: same overload rerun changes assignments or line reason cannot be traced to capacity inputs
invariants.recommended_fix: persist versioned diagnostics with reason, required/available hours, line, run and inputs

invariants.lifecycle: campaigns are recalculable only for unlocked lines; locked campaign assignments remain fixed
invariants.owner_scope: plan and work center; product category used only when exact matrix family matches
invariants.dates: campaign start/end from member period range; transitions respect date windows
invariants.locks: locked lines are excluded from regrouping/deletion
invariants.uniqueness: campaign code globally unique; sequence order deterministic per plan
invariants.transaction: rebuild all unlocked campaign assignments atomically
invariants.current_enforcement: legacy prefix grouping and default 60-minute setup did not validate family/configuration
invariants.counterexample: unrelated SKU prefixes grouped; no CIP record becomes an invented one-hour setup; locked line is detached
invariants.recommended_fix: stable exact-SKU grouping, preserve locks, apply only matching configured changeover, expose NOT_CONFIGURED

invariants.lifecycle: DRAFT -> COMPUTED; scenario never mutates the live plan
invariants.owner_scope: mps_id and created_by_id; line IDs must belong to plan
invariants.uom: change values validate against target field UOM
invariants.dates: date changes must remain parseable and scenario horizon is explicit
invariants.locks: locked lines cannot be changed by scenario
invariants.nullability: impact metrics nullable; JSON changes have no schema version in the base table
invariants.transaction: scenario and immutable input/result snapshot created in one transaction
invariants.permission: mps.simulate and warehouse scope; creator recorded
invariants.current_enforcement: line IDs plan-scoped; MERGE/SHIFT_ADD rejected; baseline cost proxy was hard-coded
invariants.counterexample: scenario cost shows a precise KES amount without currency basis; scenario result cannot be reproduced after lines change
invariants.recommended_fix: persist versioned assumptions/results, explicit KPI units, and unknown monetary values without a rate source

invariants.lifecycle: DRAFT approval requires readiness; APPROVED release all-or-none; RELEASED retry must not duplicate orders
invariants.owner_scope: actual actor, plan, inherited warehouse/company scope
invariants.uom: production order UOM from Product; no hard-coded KG
invariants.dates: scheduled interval is planned line date within plan horizon
invariants.locks: released production_order_id prevents line release duplication
invariants.uniqueness: production order number unique; MPS sequence monotonic under concurrency
invariants.nullability: actor can be null only where source user is unavailable; authenticated routes have principal
invariants.transaction: all production orders, line links, plan state, and audit event in one transaction
invariants.permission: mps.approve/release plus warehouse/company scope; segregation policy not explicitly configured
invariants.current_enforcement: approval status guard and PO sequence; audit, readiness and retry behavior incomplete
invariants.counterexample: approve with blocked lines, unauthorized company release, or retry after release creates duplicate orders
invariants.recommended_fix: row-lock, readiness check, scoped actor authorization, before/after audit, return existing result on completed retry
